identity.basis: Source is the ABN AMRO green shield; base icon shield geometry matches the source exactly (two mirrored halves meeting at a bottom point).

variant.basis: Shield-only variant selected; the grey wordmark beside the mark is not part of a standalone icon cell.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Both shield halves, the bottom point and all contours survive exactly; flat fills only, no gradients or strokes to lose; colors match the source file's own fills byte-for-byte after SVGO normalization (lowercase hex, same values).
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Whole-emblem uniform placement keeps the source aspect ratio (40.5 x 54 units inside the 54-unit cell); no clipping at any theme or export; emblem reads clearly at 24/32/48 px diagnostics; alpha preserved (transparent corners).
candidate.rationale: Shield-only working version of the fetched ABN AMRO original vector: the two shield paths with the current brand palette carried by the source file (#00A296 / #F3C000), replacing the accepted icon's outdated palette (#FDB913 / #00A195). Geometry is byte-preserved from the source; the grey wordmark beside the mark is excluded for standalone icon-cell suitability.
candidate.role: Standalone shield emblem extracted from the official lockup source vector; wordmark dropped as accompanying text.
transforms: Selected the two shield paths from the 162x40 source lockup viewBox; dropped the wordmark path and clip group.
Uniform scale 1.36674 and translation x+6.7569 place the complete shield in the 54x54 catalog cell without stretching, rotation or recoloring.
SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen repo config (multipass, precision 4/5): 373 -> 259 bytes; trial render pixel-identical to the working version on #FFFFFF and #121212 at 240px; optimized bytes selected.
candidate.variant: Current two-tone shield variant (teal field, yellow right half) in the 2020s refreshed palette; source file has a rectangular lockup canvas, no backing contour of its own — transparent standalone mark, no backing added.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Same geometry as the accepted icon; the update is the corrected current brand palette (#FDB913 -> #F3C000 yellow, #00A195 -> #00A296 teal) supported by the fetched original vector and a second Commons color-variant file. The visible difference is intentionally subtle: it is a color correction of the same mark, not a redesign.

proposals.reason: Current ABN AMRO mark verified as the green/yellow shield; an original vector (Wikimedia Commons 'ABN AMRO logo.svg', byte-identical served from upload.wikimedia.org) was fetched and bound via source-material. The base icon geometry matches the source shield but uses an outdated palette (#FDB913 yellow / #00A195 teal vs current #F3C000 / #00A296), so a palette-corrected shield candidate is justified.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Original vector of the current shield; byte-identical material bound through source-material from the fetch receipt. Shield palette update against the accepted icon is the supported update reason; the grey wordmark is dropped for standalone icon suitability.
